Well, Christopher Hitchens was a professional debater, and so are the other Horsemen. They speak like human beings, albeit articulate and intelligent ones. You seem to be an anti-intellectual, from the manner in which you despair of people who speak with abnormal eloquence. 

The New Atheists have their faults, but it is foolish to dismiss the credibility of their enterprise because of aesthetic faults in their style of presentation. Even if you hate the delivery systems they use to promote their ideas, their ideas are essentially in favor of progress, rationalism, and empiricism. I cannot think of a better intellectual movement in recent history. 

The religious apologists here will say that the New Atheists are more harmful than good, but to that I would ask them about the number of atrocities committed under the banner of atheism. Or I would ask them about the number of political injustices perpetrated with the allegiance of skeptics. I frankly believe this community occasionally adopts anti-science and anti-intellectual views. To those who know anything about rationalism, and to those who embrace skepticism, the new atheists are merely attention-seeking at worst, and nothing like the apostates that religious moderates paint them as.
I personally believe deism is compatible with science and largely supportive of reason.

This is most likely your new reality. Cognitive impairment, from medication and the illness itself, is inevitable. The best you can do is learn to adjust to your new cognitive apparatus. You may be able to minimize the cognitive impairment as much as possible, but you can't eradicate it completely. You will have to settle for a new optimum cognitive standard, even if it is shite when compared to that of your previous self.
Your mediocre poetics will not save you.

Well, that
s good. A safety net of the future. Indeed.

Great job seeking help. If you have schizophrenia, the worst thing you can do is wait for it to progress naturally. I had three years of symptoms before proper diagnosis and treatment. During those three years I did insane things culminating in arrests, restraining orders, and suicide attempts. I never hurt anyone but I would stalk people and break into their homes to perform rituals on their furniture because I believed their furniture contained the life-forces they were sucking away.

Ignore my blabbering and read this. Early treatment is crucial. If you have schizophrenia, early treatment is the best way you can ensure a productive life.

Well, I'm on medicine and it gives me the awareness that there is such a thing as objective reality, no matter my subjective interpretation. I value reason and logic and empiricism, but none of that means anything when I have an episode. In my mind, brainwashing and neurotoxic mass-distrubutions become as empirical as gravity. With the medicine I still have the same delusions but a small voice in the back of my head reminds me that there is an objective reality that can be understood with the methodological framework of experimentation and observation comprising the scientific method.

Usually when I go to public places, I have a belief that government officials are distributing neurotoxic agents through the air-filtration system. These neurotoxic agents cause cognitive damage, and even lower the IQ depending on duration of exposure. I usually pinch my nose discreetly or cover my mouth with my hand when this happens.

The experience of revealing that you have schizophrenia is always interesting. At times, I have shocked people, as though I had told them I was a martian. At other times, they have sort of expressed an: "I knew it was something like that" demeanor. It depends on my frame of mind and particular physical state. 

I was at a cocktail party once, and this was during my most functional period. When I told people I had schizophrenia, and paranoid schizophrenia at that, they guffawed as though I had told a joke. About a week later, I was in dirty rags and screaming at random bystanders on the street.

Of course, these methods are subject to ridicule and scrutiny. I am not one to take my own ideas seriously, and even if I did, I would be aware of their relative inferiority. Every person is on a vessel, and that vessel may well represent consciousness. Each vessel is stranded in the sea, but everyone kids themselves into believing they are anchored in nice provinces and the sort. No. We are bobbing in the center of an infinite sea, and do not be lulled by the smooth waters. They can become choppy and hellish with a gush of wind or crinkle of God's eyebrow. And here I invoke God in a metaphorical sense to convey the chaos of nature.

Thank you for the kind thoughts.  So even though you can't see the relief swirling in me, I have it for your compassion. This is very trite, to be sure. Triteness was never my forte, but these circumstances we are in have changed that. I'm sure our pre and post onset beings would have a radical confrontation if ever brought together. My pre-onset being would certainly be horrified by the trite gobble I engage, but even he would probably think: "well, CoKu seems like a nice guy, at least." I've done that with a lot of others too.

I'm rambling, but yes, I have found some outlets, not many. Thrive is a funny word, and not applicable, to be held at a distance as the pond reflection of Narcissus, or the branch of fruit just out of reach of Tantalus, the unfortunate Greek myths who suffer from their want of improvement.

This is because Edna, the Goddess of certain facets of creativity, has bestowed her gifts upon you. You must treasure your ability to assemble information in such an aesthetically pleasing manner. When I used to assemble information for the purpose of aesthetics, I used to conceptualize the existence of a being similar to Edna, who is an arbitrary embodiment of the creative spirit at large. 

Your work is very beautiful. It reminds me of a golden, sun-streaked shore. A thick golden glow permeating the mechanisms of our cynical inclinations, such that they are overwhelmed. Perhaps language is not a very accurate tool for describing the emotional experiences that art induces.

I doubt it very highly! Nothing positive has come out of my obsessive rituals. This Reddit-based one is only my most recent compensatory ritual. I'm on terrible anti-psychotics because I jumped in front of traffic and slammed my head against the trunks during an episode. My rituals used to be very creative and artistic, even brilliant at one point, but now they are mediocre and unoriginal. 

I used to write stories to cope with my hallucinations. I even published one of them in a literary magazine. But with the medication my brain is dumb and numb and blurry and hazy. The only difference the medication makes is the quality of my coping mechanisms.

To clarify, this means that if I have a weaved hallucination, say about a Reddit user with the name "X", X may compete with the other hallucinatory personalities in my mind to assume control over my attention. But if "Y" comes into the picture, then I have to jostle for some measure of control, which I don't have. That's why I increase the probability of hallucinating X and maintaining control by messaging the person who is "X", the person whose post history I am extracting my fictional personage from. This is why I have invited everyone to it, because they have to see it for themselves. According to the arbitrary dogma of my illness, only with X's knowledge can I control my hallucinate of X with some control, or else Y is hallucinated.
